display.name: Coda
display.summary: Searches, reads, and updates Coda docs, pages, and tables for the signed-in account.
examples: What is in the roadmap doc?
Add a row to the tasks table.
Summarise the comments on the launch page.

agent.name: coda
agent.description: Searches and updates the Coda docs the signed-in account can see: pages, tables, rows, comments, and formulas. A question naming a doc without saying which system holds it may be here or in another document store. Coda URLs and docs.superhuman.com URLs are both here.
agent.owns:
You own the Coda docs this account can see, including docs.superhuman.com. You can search, read, create, and update pages, tables, rows, comments, and controls. You cannot delete a doc, page, table, row, column, view, comment, or control.

Decode a URL with url_convert before any other call. Then search or content_read, then create or update.

You do not own Notion or Confluence.

tool_descriptions.search: Search for content across documents, pages, tables, rows, folders, and people, or list documents by recency. Returns ranked results with URLs. Supports cursor-based pagination. Then read the page or table this returns.
tool_descriptions.url_convert: Convert between resource URIs (coda:// or superhuman://) and web URLs. Use action "encode" for URI to https, or "decode" for https to URI (returns {uri, docUri}). On decode, pass scope to pin the depth of the returned URI. Decode a Coda or docs.superhuman.com URL before any other call.
tool_descriptions.whoami: Get the current authenticated user information (ID, name, email) AND the workspaces they belong to. For any other named person, use name_match with {type:"person"} instead.
tool_descriptions.tool_guide: Get detailed guidance before working in specific areas. Accepts a single topic, or a batch of topics with optional subTopics for in-depth references (formula functions, reaction icons, personal filter formats, etc.).
tool_descriptions.name_match: Match approximate page, table, view, or person names to candidates in the document. Returns matched URIs / user profiles ranked by similarity. Batch up to 20 lookups per call. For the current user, use whoami instead.
tool_descriptions.notifications_list: List the current user's notifications (mentions), newest first. Defaults to unread.
tool_descriptions.notifications_mark_read: Mark notifications read by the mention timestamps returned by notifications_list. Mark only the notifications the user selected.
tool_descriptions.allow_locked_page_edits: Record that this connection may edit locked pages. Call only after the user agrees. A later write in this connection then bypasses the lock. The lock stays on the page.
tool_descriptions.document_create: Create a new Coda document. Call tool_guide with "document" topic first for usage patterns.
tool_descriptions.document_outline: Outline a document: document metadata (title, icon, createdAt, owner, sourceDoc) plus a paginated list of its pages with per-page metadata and child page outlines. The document's structure, not its body content.
tool_descriptions.document_manage: Change a document's access control (add, update, or revoke a permission) or move the document to a different folder. Requires share access; moving also requires edit access.
tool_descriptions.schema_explain: Map a document's tables, columns, views, and the lookups between them. Returns each node's uri, name, and kind.
tool_descriptions.page_create: Create a new page. To copy existing pages or documents, use content_duplicate instead. Call tool_guide with "page" topic for options.
tool_descriptions.page_update: Update an existing page. Call tool_guide with "page" topic for options.
tool_descriptions.page_describe: Describe page metadata (title, pageType, isHidden, parentPageUri, position, icon, coverPhoto, subtitle, canvasUri, authors, timestamps, child page outlines). Page URIs only — for body content call content_read.
tool_descriptions.table_create: Create a new table on a page with specified columns and optional initial data. Supports various column types, formulas, and positioning. Call tool_guide with "table" topic for column types.
tool_descriptions.table_rows_read: Read row data from a table with cell values. Pass table uri directly. When uri points to a view, the response includes baseTable data so the agent can tell it's working with a view rather than the underlying table.
tool_descriptions.table_rows_manage: Add or update table rows. Use action “add” to insert new rows, or “update” to modify existing rows. Supports markdown formatting in cell values (bold, italic, color and highlight; tool_guide gives the syntax). Call tool_guide with “table” topic for usage patterns.
tool_descriptions.table_columns_manage: Add or update table columns (name, type, formula). For action “update”: cannot change cell text formatting — use table_rows_manage with markdown instead. Call tool_guide with “table” topic for column types.
tool_descriptions.table_view_manage: Add a new view to a table (action "add") or configure an existing view (action "configure"). Supports name, layout (including charts), filters (shared and personal), sorts, groups, column visibility, column order, conditional formatting, and title visibility.
tool_descriptions.table_columns_read: Read a table's column schema: column names, IDs, isWritable flag, format.type, formula bodies, and rowCount. Pass include: ['formats'] for full per-variant format details, or include: ['views'] for view configs.
tool_descriptions.content_modify: Modify canvas content: insert, replace, or delete elements, or make headings and tables collapsible/foldable via set_collapsible. Inline formatting: bold, italic, color and highlight (tool_guide gives the syntax). For tabular data, prefer table_create over Markdown tables. Call tool_guide with “content” topic first for usage patterns.
tool_descriptions.content_duplicate: Duplicate content from one location to another. Can copy pages and documents into both new or existing documents. Call tool_guide with "content" topic for usage patterns.
tool_descriptions.content_image_upload: Upload an image to a canvas placeholder, OR (omit blobId) mint a pre-signed S3 upload URL — use the returned imageUrl with table_rows_manage to write into a table image/attachment cell. Two modes: (1) provide imageUrl to upload directly from an https:// URL, or (2) omit imageUrl and provide contentType to get an uploadUrl for local file upload via curl. Base64 data URLs are not supported. Call tool_guide with "content" topic for usage patterns.
tool_descriptions.comment_add: Add a comment, reply, or emoji reaction to a page element, table row, comment thread, or specific comment. Call tool_guide with "comment" topic for usage patterns.
tool_descriptions.comment_resolve: Mark a comment thread as resolved, or reopen a resolved thread.
tool_descriptions.content_read: Read body content of a page or cell canvas. Accepts a page URI, a page-canvas URI, or a cell-canvas URI (returned as canvasUri by table_rows_read for canvas-typed cells). Call tool_guide with "page" topic for content type options.
tool_descriptions.document_suggest_changes: Propose tracked suggestions on line content of a page or a canvas cell. A reviewer accepts or rejects each suggestion. This does not apply a live edit.
tool_descriptions.formula_execute: Evaluate a Coda Formula Language (CFL) expression and return the result. Requires a document URI. Call tool_guide with "formula" topic first for usage patterns.
tool_descriptions.control_manage: Create or update a canvas control (formula, button, reaction, checkbox, text box, slider, or date picker). Use action "create" to add a new control, or "update" to modify an existing one. Formula controls support the full column-format vocabulary (currency, scale, slider, lookup, etc.). Call tool_guide with "formula" topic for usage.
tool_descriptions.control_read: Read a canvas control's full configuration by its formula or control URI — any control type, not just formulas and buttons. Returns type, current value, and the control's type-specific configuration (a button's label/actionFormula/color/disableIfFormula, a slider's minimum/maximum, a reaction's imageIcon); formula controls also carry formula/error. Obtain the URI from content_read (include "controls" or "formulas").
